title: shivpedia: what a session learns in one repo, the next repo starts with
why: Owner, Nov 1 21:02 CST: "even broader than this, it's like if i learned how to build seomthing better one way, i should be able to utilize that again some other day" Just how a carpenter gets more skilled with his experience, similarly we should too, rather than always being a new laborer in each repo!". Grep found no home for lessons today (only decision guard-guards-mistakes-only mentions one).
note:
Nov 6 (owner item 150 a): the full plan, draft PR #1034, waits on step shivpedia-count. No build lane starts before it.
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): TODO: plan PR #1034 is open. Not live: no lane and no open PR.
Name (owner, Nov 1 21:05 CST): "we pull in claude-settings as the overarching parent for all the other repos for a reason -- call it shivpedia". One shared book, shivpedia, in claude-settings, by topic (testing, CI, merging and batches, guards and checks, UI and design, records and prose, orchestration). Each entry: one "do this" line, the evidence that earned it (repo, PR or incident), and where it applies. Feed: every lane's closing report names its lessons (zero is fine); a harvester (triage or the lane close step) folds each into the book, or into the skill that owns the topic (one home per capability). Reuse: a session loads the topics its task touches before it plans, by path or by task. Measure: a lesson that repeats as a new incident counts as a miss. Step test-practices-first-principles becomes shivpedia's testing chapter. Source: coordinator Nov 1 21:20 CST. Port: yes, every repo. Ready; placed high in order. Widened (owner, Nov 1 21:07 CST): "it can't be taken as evergreen commandments either, instead, it's moreso just experiences ... maybe we need to do a larger refactor of our prose, just ensure an opus agent is coordinating this plan and don't do too much actual building work until your entire plan e-t-e is completely signed off with every piece of the build double checked". Now a plan-only prose refactor across claude-settings: shivpedia holds experiences, not commandments; an Opus agent coordinates the plan; no build until the owner signs off on the whole plan. When the plan PR lands, triage files a sign-off item on the page. Lane prose-unmapped started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
